results.title: Cedars-Sinai Medical Center - Wikipedia
results.content:
Cedars-Sinai Medical Center is a 919-bed teaching hospital and research center in Los Angeles, California.

It is part of the Cedars-Sinai Health System, which includes other hospitals and a network of local doctors' offices that display its name along with a number of research institutes.

The hospital is certified as a Level I trauma center. It has a staff of over 2,000 physicians and 10,000 employees, supported by 2,000 volunteers and more than 40 community groups. [...] | Cedars-Sinai Health System |

results.title: Cedars-Sinai Medical Center in Los Angeles, CA - Rankings & Ratings
results.content: Located in Los Angeles, California, Cedars-Sinai Medical Center is a general medical and surgical hospital serving the Los Angeles County community. Cedars-Sinai Medical Center is on the Best Hospitals Honor Roll. It is nationally ranked in 10 adult specialties and rated high performing in 24 adult procedures and conditions, including Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Repair, Aortic Valve Surgery, Back Surgery (Spinal Fusion), Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) and Colon Cancer Surgery. It is [...] Cedars-Sinai Medical Center is nationally ranked number 5 in Orthopedics by U.S. News & World Report. In addition to its national standing, it is the #1 ranked orthopedics center in California and the #1 ranked orthopedics center in the Los Angeles metro area. Cedars-Sinai Medical Center is rated High Performing in the following procedures and conditions related to Orthopedics: Back Surgery (Spinal Fusion), Hip Fracture, Hip Replacement and Knee Replacement. [...] Cedars-Sinai Medical Center is nationally ranked number 4 in Cardiology, Heart & Vascular Surgery by U.S. News & World Report. In addition to its national standing, it is the #1 ranked cardiology center in California and the #1 ranked cardiology center in the Los Angeles metro area. Cedars-Sinai Medical Center is rated High Performing in the following procedures and conditions related to Cardiology, Heart & Vascular Surgery: Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Repair, Aortic Valve Surgery, Heart
